how_to_read_precision: Malicious records are over-represented here by roughly 1/benign_sampling_fraction. Precision measured on this file is optimistic by about that factor and must be corrected to true_base_rate before it is quoted. Recall needs no correction: every red-team record is present.
positive_class_warning: The positive class is 702 records and cannot grow — the corpus contains no more labelled attacks. Size confidence in any recall figure to that number, not to the file.
